lines.text: Today: Hormuz, ICA's new warehouse map, and why A I pilots stall.

lines.text: To Sweden. ICA has updated its logistics masterplan. It swaps single-category central warehouses for three regional hubs, in Helsingborg, Västerås and Göteborg.
